message.content: {"question":"In a region of space there is the potential energy U(x y z) = b(x² + y² + z²) - bxy + c where b and c are constants of suitable size. What is the analytical expression of the force?", "options":{"A":"F(x,y,z)=b(-2x+xy)i+b(-2y+xy)j-2bzk","B":"F(x,y,z)=b(2x-y)i+b(2y-x)j+(2bz+c)k","C":"F(x,y,z)=b(2x-y)i+b(2y-x)j+2bzk","D":"F(x,y,z)=b(-2x+y)i+b(-2y+x)j-2bzk"},"correct":"D"}
